signIn.title: Sign In
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back — let's continue your child's journey.

forgotPassword.title: Forget Password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Use your registered email and we'll send you a verification code to reset your password.
forgotPassword.successBody: If an account exists for this email, a reset link is on its way.

otp.title: Enter Verification Code
otp.subtitle: We've sent a 4-digit code to your email. Please enter it below.
otp.errorExpired: This code has expired. Request a new one.

setPassword.title: Set Password
setPassword.subtitle: Create a secure password to access your account.
setPassword.successBody: You can now access your child's nursery portal.

invite.welcomeBody: You've been invited to follow your child's day at the nursery. We'll keep you updated with care.
invite.expiredBody: This invitation link has expired, Please contact the nursery to request a new invitation.
